label: Bible Study
prompt: For as he _____ in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verse: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
note: Often quoted about mindset — in context, it's a warning about a stingy host's fake hospitality.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye shall eat in _____, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verse: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
note: After the locusts, a promise of plenty to eat — and 'my people shall never be ashamed.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe _____. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
verse: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
note: Baby Moses cried at the perfect moment — and the princess's heart melted, even knowing he was a Hebrew child.

label: Deep Water
prompt: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the _____ serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verse: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
note: Hezekiah smashed the bronze serpent Moses had made — Israel had turned the old relic into an idol.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and _____ of heart,
verse: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
note: The first church: daily together, breaking bread house to house, with 'gladness and singleness of heart.'
